note: A fused x + 1 activation shared by two stored weight channels, the no-cut shape of a gate/up projection: the compute threads fill the activation slab while both weights ride a two-slot TMA ring under the p2 register double buffer. 20 rows leave a partial M tile and K = 512 wraps the ring eight times. The compute fill used to offer only its cp.async ring here, so a TMA pin failed unless the activation was cut into its own kernel.

attrs.body:
in0 = load add_c1[0]
for a0 in 0..20:
    for a1 in 0..128:
        for a2 in 0..512:
            in1 = load linear_1_wt[a2, a1]
            in2 = load linear_wt[a2, a1]
            in3 = load x[a0, a2]
            v0 = add(in0, in3)
            f32 v1 = multiply(in1, v0)
            acc0 <- add(acc0, v1) over a2
            f32 v2 = multiply(in2, v0)
            acc1 <- add(acc1, v2) over a2
        f16 v3 = copy(acc0)
        f16 v4 = copy(acc1)
        v5 = multiply(v3, v4)
        mul[a0, a1] = v5
